description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Migrate the Oracle Database data source and credentials to Azure Database for PostgreSQL with managed identity. Adapt the data model and SQL, including photo BLOB storage, for PostgreSQL.
tasks.reason: The application currently uses Oracle Database with Oracle-specific JDBC driver, OracleDialect, BLOB data types, and plaintext credentials. Azure Database for PostgreSQL is the target managed relational database service on Azure, and managed identity replaces the current plaintext credential configuration.
tasks.requirements: Migrate the Oracle JDBC data source, JPA dialect, SQL syntax, and schema definitions to Azure Database for PostgreSQL. Replace the Oracle JDBC driver with the PostgreSQL driver and update Spring datasource configuration and Hibernate dialect. Convert Oracle BLOB columns used to store photo binary data to PostgreSQL bytea, and convert any Oracle-specific SQL queries in repositories to PostgreSQL-compatible syntax. Update application.properties and application-docker.properties to use the Azure Database for PostgreSQL endpoint and managed identity authentication, removing plaintext database credentials.
